_comment: The Ethereum mainnet deployment, filled 11 October 2026 except the two values only the artist decides (checklists/0-launch-steps.md, then 1-pre-deploy.md and 2-deploy.md). The auction values are the decided launch settings; on chain 1 script/DeployKilim.s.sol refuses any other, any deployer but orkhanart.eth, a skipped nonce check, a zero minLeadSeconds, a missing or different expected block, and a deployer with code. The texts equal the packed manifests; the expected block is pnpm -s expected for the stores packed from the final artwork (mint/artwork.html SHA-256 bbc7b408..., with the 30-motif rank named Spinner). minLeadSeconds is 86400, the recommended 24-hour inspection window. Both TODO fields must be whole numbers without quotes before either command runs (the script cannot read the config while they are text).

auction.startsAt: TODO: the launch date, when registration opens, in unix seconds (not milliseconds). It must be at least 86400 seconds (minLeadSeconds) after the block runContracts lands in, and less than 365 days after it. Example: python3 -c 'import calendar,time; print(calendar.timegm(time.strptime("2026-11-20 18:00", "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M")))' for 20 November 2026, 18:00 UTC.
